title: Pushing a heavy cart (straight heel-to-head diagonal)
summary: Walk_Loop at its widest stride (t 0) + whole-body tilt .45 about the rear foot + hip hinge .22 + lean .12, hands IK'd to the cart's rear rim. Push_Loop is crouched with the arms overhead: don't.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: tilt(f, .45); S.tick(() => { f.act('Walk_Loop', { t: 0 }); hinge(f, .22); lean(f, .12, -.2); f.handTo('R', rimR, { weight: 1, curl: .7 }); f.handTo('L', rimL, { weight: 1, curl: .7 }); });

doc.when: Anyone pushing a cart, a trolley, a car, a door, a crate.
doc.avoid: Push_Loop (crouched, arms overhead) and spine lean alone (looks upright).
gotchas: tilt() once in build after placing; hinge/lean every tick after the clip.
Scale 1.5 was fitted to an AI reference that draws people big.
